mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super that throws a slow, single-hit disc with a considerable startup. The disc has mild tracking and is unblockable, can restand the opponent on hit, and can be fired without a lock-on and then made to track after relocking. Exact tracking parameters and current frame data remain unresolved.
